tasks.title: Add $casts to models batch 1 (20 files) in this repo (project root). Working data: the file ai-multiagents/plans/casts_spec.json maps relative model file paths to cast specs, e.g. "app/Models/HumanResources/OptBranch.php": {"id": "integer"}. For EACH of the EXACT files listed below, open ai-multiagents/plans/casts_spec.json, read the cast spec for that exact relative path, and add a protected $casts = [ ... ]; block to that model class following these rules: (1) cast type values come verbatim from the spec (integer, boolean, float, date, datetime, decimal:2, etc.) - do NOT invent casts for columns not in the spec and do NOT add string casts; (2) MERGE rule - if the model already has an ACTIVE (non-commented) $casts block, keep every existing entry and only add spec keys that are not already present (existing entries win on conflicts, e.g. HRAttendance already casts 'exception' => 'boolean' so keep boolean even if the spec says integer); if the existing block is fully commented out, replace it with the real block from the spec; (3) place the block right after the protected $fillable array (or after protected $table when there is no fillable), using TAB indentation (a literal tab character before protected and before each entry) and single quotes exactly like the rest of the file, and keep the trailing comma on every line; (4) do not touch anything else in the file and do NOT edit any file outside this exact list. Files: app/Models/ActivityLog.php, app/Models/Customer.php, app/Models/HumanResources/AppraisalPivot.php, app/Models/HumanResources/ConditionalIncentiveCategory.php, app/Models/HumanResources/ConditionalIncentiveCategoryItem.php, app/Models/HumanResources/ConditionalIncentiveStaffItemWeek.php, app/Models/HumanResources/DepartmentPivot.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAppraisalMainQuestion.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAppraisalMark.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAppraisalQuestion.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAppraisalSection.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAppraisalSectionSub.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAppraisalSetting.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAttendance.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAttendancePayslipSetting.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRAttendanceRemark.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRDisciplinary.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRHolidayCalendar.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeaveAmend.php, app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeaveAnnual.php. After editing, run php -l on every touched file - all must report No syntax errors. Do not run the test suite in this task. Report the list of files edited with the exact cast count added per file, and any file where an existing cast was kept per the merge rule.

Verify the casts addition across all models in this repo (project root) did not break anything. Steps: (1) run php -l on every file under app/Models - all must report No syntax errors, report any failures; (2) run the full PHP test suite `php artisan test` - must stay green (baseline: 47 passed / 159 assertions); (3) spot-check that cast blocks are well-formed: run php artisan tinker --execute=check on at least 6 models spread across the batches (e.g. OptBranch, HRLeave, Staff, Sales, Login, HROvertime) confirming getCasts() returns non-empty arrays with the expected integer/boolean/date types; (4) run php artisan view:cache and confirm Blade templates compile, then php artisan view:clear. Report the exact test run result (suites, passed, failed, assertion count) with the test report contract, the php -l summary, and the getCasts() output for the spot-checked models.

tasks.title: Write a changelog doc for the casts addition in this repo (project root): create docs/changelog/2026-08-16-casts-all-models.md documenting that protected $casts blocks were added to all 78 model files under app/Models based on the live MySQL database schema (ipmaerp, MySQL 8.0), following standard Laravel type mapping (integer, boolean, float, date, datetime, decimal:2), with the merge rule that pre-existing active cast entries were preserved (notable keeps: HRAttendance exception => boolean, Sales spec_req/urgency => boolean + date_order/delivery_at/confirm_date => date, SalesJobDescription quantity => decimal:2, ActivityLog changes/snapshot/meta => array + is_critical => boolean, Login email_verified_at => datetime + password => hashed), and that commented-out scaffold cast blocks (HRLeave, SalesAmend) were replaced with real ones. Reference the plan file ai-multiagents/plans/casts-add-all-models.json and the working data ai-multiagents/plans/casts_spec.json. Do not invent facts - only state what is in the plan, the spec, and the verification results reported by the tester. Report the doc file path and a one-paragraph summary.
